figures.finding: Russia's national film fund is the Fond Kino (Federal Fund for Social and Economic Support of National Cinematography), which selects films for production support in separate tracks; in 2026 it approved 23 national films by the 'leaders of national film production' (19 June 2026) and 40 fiction films by other film organisations (4 August 2026), after open defences at the Ministry of Culture. Its share of a budget and cap per film were not found (see blockers).
